## 中文

- 强化简历导入与本地文档解析：补齐 PDF CJK 字符映射，支持通过本地解析器处理 `text/rtf`，简化 DOCX 回退路径，并将含修订/批注（含表格修订）的 Word 与未渲染的 HTML/ODT 文档保留在本地审阅。
- 建立跨平台（macOS / Linux / Windows）DSH 冒烟验证 CI 与 npm Trusted Publishing 自动化发布流水线，在 Ubuntu PDF 往返测试中安装中文字体并串行执行浏览器测试。

## English

- Hardened resume imports and local document parsing: bundled PDF CJK CMaps, routed `text/rtf` uploads through the local parser, simplified DOCX fallback, and kept Word documents with tracked revisions (including table edits) as well as unrendered HTML/ODT imports in local review.
- Added cross-platform (macOS / Linux / Windows) DSH smoke CI and npm Trusted Publishing release automation, with CJK fonts and serial browser-backed tests on Ubuntu.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nimbus318/dsh-niuma-broker/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
